_help: Price overrides. Official MOBI.E operator tariffs are loaded automatically every day; use this file only to fix or add a price.
All amounts in EUR. kwh = price per kWh, min = price per minute, start = fixed fee per session, note = free text, updated = date you checked.
'stations' overrides one charger by its MOBI.E code (e.g. FNC-00012), shown at the bottom of the charger's card.
'operators' applies to chargers that have no official price, when the operator name contains the key (case-insensitive).
